facts.material: outer shell of cellular polyurethane plastic with 100% polyester woven backing merely for reinforcement; woven polyester lining quilted to nonwoven polyester batting; sherpa collar; rib knit cuffs and bottom
facts.form: complete garment with full front zipper, long sleeves, zippered pockets

gri_path: Chapter 59 note 2(a)(5): textile fabrics combined with cellular plastics where the textile is present merely for reinforcement are excluded from heading 5903 and are treated as plastics of chapter 39
Chapter 62 note/section XI: the outer shell is therefore not a textile fabric, so the garment is not apparel of chapters 61/62 (which require textile outer shell)
GRI 1 / GRI 3(b): outer shell of plastic gives the jacket its essential character; heading 3926 articles of apparel of plastics
GRI 6: 3926.20 articles of apparel; not seamless, not PVC rainwear valued not over $10; 3926.20.90 other; suffix .50 other (not aprons)

rejected_alternatives.reason: outer shell is cellular plastic with backing merely for reinforcement, which is a chapter 39 material under chapter 59 note 2(a)(5), not a textile of chapter 62
garments of 5903 fabrics require a textile fabric coated/laminated with plastics; here the textile is merely reinforcement for cellular plastic, excluded from 5903
PVC rainwear valued not over $10; this shell is polyurethane

classification.rationale: The outer shell is cellular polyurethane with a woven polyester backing present merely for reinforcement, so under chapter 59 note 2(a)(5) the shell material is a plastic of chapter 39, not a textile. The jacket is therefore an article of apparel of plastics of heading 3926, and CBP has classified such faux suede/cellular PU jackets in 3926.20.9050 (NY N326796, in force). The gender of the wearer does not affect this line.
